references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, the Midianite woman who was brought into the camp is mentioned, and she is later identified as Cozbi.
Zur, Cozbi's father, is named as one of the five Midianite kings killed by the Israelites in the war against Midian.
Cozbi is again mentioned as the daughter of a Midianite chief, in connection with the treachery of the Midianites at Peor.
The Lord's command to take vengeance on the Midianites, following the incident involving Cozbi and the idolatry at Peor.
Zur is mentioned as one of the Midianite chiefs who were subject to Sihon, king of Heshbon.
